About Our Saree & Lehenga Care Service

Silk, zari, sequins and heavy embroidery are easy to damage with the wrong method. Cleanzit inspects every saree, lehenga and ethnic outfit before accepting it, checks the fabric and embellishment, and picks a cleaning method to match. If a piece carries a risk — loose work, a colour that may run — we tell you before cleaning.

Sarees start at ₹120+, lehengas at ₹375+ and women's 3-piece suits are ₹180. During wedding and festival season, book a pickup a few days before you need an outfit back.

What's included

Caring for silk and embroidered outfits

  • Spray perfume before dressing, not directly onto silk or zari.
  • Store sarees wrapped in muslin or cotton cloth, not plastic.
  • Refold silk sarees every few months so creases don't set permanently along the folds.
  • Get stains cleaned soon after the event — turmeric and oil get harder to remove over time.
